de.abas.erp.common.type.enums

Enum EnumReasonForFinancialEntry

  • Object
    • Enum<EnumReasonForFinancialEntry>
      • EnumReasonForFinancialEntry
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AbasEnum, AbasType, Serializable, Cloneable, Comparable<EnumReasonForFinancialEntry>

    public enum EnumReasonForFinancialEntry
extends Enum<EnumReasonForFinancialEntry>
implements AbasEnum
    This java enum represents the standard abas erp enumeration Cause of financial entry (A51).
    It is independent from a specific ERP client.
